name: Curse of Vanishing
description:
This item disappears upon death rather than dropping.

  • [term:curse][red]Curse Spell[/red][/term]: [dark-red]Sacrifice 1❤️[/dark-red] to release a cylindrical void that extends forward 10 blocks over 1 second, making enemies [effect:liminal][dark-gray]liminal[/dark-gray][/effect]. If a liminal enemy rematerializes inside a block or another enemy, they both take 8❤️ damage.

effects.explanation: Liminal enemies are erased from existence for up to 2 seconds based on their distance from you, after which they rematerialize in the same relative location.
